milestones.title: AstroSDK 2.0 - Milestone 0: Architecture Baseline
milestones.description: Create the 2.0 architectural spine without breaking the current app. Establish contexts, grouped domains and services, capability metadata, and migration rules.

issues.title: Epic: Establish AstroSDK 2.0 architecture baseline
issues.body:
## Goal
Create the internal AstroSDK 2.0 structure without disrupting the current runtime.

## Scope
- Add the 2.0 architectural spine
- Keep current API behavior intact
- Make the new layout the default target for new work

## Deliverables
- `app/contexts/`
- grouped `app/domain/*`
- grouped `app/services/*`
- capability and maturity registry
- migration guidance for existing modules

## Acceptance Criteria
- New structure exists in the repository
- Current tests still pass
- New feature work can target the 2.0 layout immediately

issues.title: Create 2.0 context package for calculation, zodiac, coordinate, observer, house, and feature settings
issues.body:
## Goal
Replace loose calculation flags with explicit context objects.

## Scope
- Add `CalculationContext`
- Add `ZodiacContext`
- Add `CoordinateContext`
- Add `ObserverContext`
- Add `HouseContext`
- Add `FeatureContext`

## Acceptance Criteria
- Context classes exist and are importable
- Context objects can express current core calculation modes
- New services can depend on contexts instead of raw flags

issues.title: Introduce grouped domain namespaces under app/domain for astronomy, western, vedic, mundane, research, and common
issues.body:
## Goal
Reorganize domain models around calculation domains rather than a flat module set.

## Scope
- Create `app/domain/common`
- Create `app/domain/astronomy`
- Create `app/domain/western`
- Create `app/domain/vedic`
- Create `app/domain/mundane`
- Create `app/domain/research`

## Acceptance Criteria
- Namespaces exist with initial exports
- Existing domain models can begin migrating into grouped modules
- No API breakage is introduced solely by this structural change

milestones.title: AstroSDK 2.0 - Milestone 1: Core Determinism Hardening
milestones.description: Make calculation modes, Swiss Ephemeris global state, and reproducibility metadata explicit and safe across the engine.

issues.title: Epic: Harden core determinism and explicit calculation contracts
issues.body:
## Goal
Make AstroSDK's core runtime predictable, auditable, and safe under growth.

## Scope
- unify global-state handling
- replace hidden defaults with explicit contexts
- add reproducibility metadata
- expand determinism test coverage

## Acceptance Criteria
- Core calculations are context-driven
- Global Swiss state is protected consistently
- Calculation metadata can reproduce outputs reliably

issues.title: Centralize Swiss Ephemeris state mutation behind one lock and one runtime boundary
issues.body:
## Goal
Remove fragmented state management around Swiss Ephemeris.

## Scope
- centralize lock usage
- isolate sidereal, topocentric, and tidal state changes
- audit all `swe.*` call sites

## Acceptance Criteria
- All state mutation flows use the shared runtime boundary
- No service mutates Swiss state outside approved pathways

issues.title: Refactor new and migrated services to use explicit calculation contexts instead of loose flags
issues.body:

## Scope

- document context-to-runtime mapping

## Acceptance Criteria
- New service APIs accept explicit contexts
- Transitional adapters exist where needed
- Tropical, sidereal, geo, helio, and topo modes are explicit

issues.title: Add calculation fingerprinting and reproducibility metadata
issues.body:

## Scope

## Acceptance Criteria

- Metadata contract is documented and testable

issues.title: Expand determinism test coverage for tropical/sidereal and geo/helio/topocentric mode parity
issues.body:

## Scope

## Acceptance Criteria

- Regressions similar to recent audit findings are locked down
